San Jose

Beginner-friendly group rides in San Jose, CA

2 rides · newest check Oct 26, 2026

First group ride? Start here →

Alto Velo Coffee and Cake Ride, Road Some Sundays (about once a month), 9:10 am · Los Altos Waits for youEasy pace30 miChecked Oct 1 · Confirm first
Velo Girls Melo Velo, Road Every Sunday, 9:00 am · Woodside 10 mph15 miChecked Oct 26
About these 2 rides

Both ride on Sundays. The earliest start is Velo Girls Melo Velo at 9:00 am; the latest is Alto Velo Coffee and Cake Ride at 9:10 am. The group waits for everyone on 1 of them (no-drop). There’s one ride made for women, trans and femme riders. Both are road rides. Both were checked at the source between Oct 1 and Oct 26, 2026.
